course.title: Structured Programming
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Write a C program that will take filename(s) as command line arguments, read the files and (11) [CO3] display the contents if they exists. Give proper explanation of your implementation.

topics: Input and Output: Standard input and output, Formatted input and output, File access, Dynamic memory allocation, Valgrind, Garbage collection, Variable length argument list, Command line parameters, Error handling, Introduction to graphics routines, Compiling, Make file, Debugging.
Functions and Program Structures: Function basics, Parameter passing conventions, Scope rules and storage classes, Recursion, Header files, Preprocessor, Arrays.
_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
classification_notes: প্রশ্নটিতে command line arguments (Topic 5), file access/read contents (Topic 5), এবং function usage for program structure (Topic 2) ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।
verification_notes: প্রশ্নটিতে command line arguments এবং file I/O এর প্রয়োজনীয়তা সঠিকভাবে চিহ্নিত করা হয়েছে যা নির্দিষ্ট টপিকগুলোর সাথে সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।
